record.paper_title: Bounded compact and dual compact approximation properties of Hardy spaces: new results and open problems
record.context_brief: Sharper BCAP bounds for Hardy-Lorentz spaces
record.original_question: For the Hardy-Lorentz space H[L^{p,q}] with 1 ≤ q ≤ p < ∞, find a nontrivial lower bound for the bounded compact approximation constant M(H[L^{p,q}]) and improve the upper bound M(H[L^{p,q}]) ≤ 2 given in equation (5.9).

evidence.quote: Open problem 5.8. (a) Let 1 ≤ q ≤ p < ∞. Find a nontrivial lower bound for M(H[Lp,q]). Improve the upper bound for M(H[Lp,q]) given by (5.9).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Setup. Let $\mathbb{T}$ denote the unit circle with normalized Lebesgue measure. For $1<p<\infty$ and $1\le q<\infty$, the Lorentz space $L^{p,q}(\mathbb{T})$ consists of all measurable functions $f$ on $\mathbb{T}$ with
$$\|f\|_{L^{p,q}} = \left(\int_0^\infty \big(t^{1/p} f^{*}(t)\big)^q \frac{dt}{t}\right)^{1/q}<\infty,$$
where $f^{*}$ is the nonincreasing rearrangement of $|f|$. The Hardy–Lorentz space $H[L^{p,q}]$ is the closed subspace of $L^{p,q}(\mathbb{T})$ consisting of those $f$ whose Fourier coefficients $\hat{f}(n)$ vanish for all $n<0$.

A Banach space $X$ is said to have the bounded compact approximation property (BCAP) with constant $C\ge 1$ if there exists a net (or, when $X$ is separable, a sequence) $\{T_\alpha\}$ of compact operators on $X$ with $\sup_\alpha \|T_\alpha\|\le C$ such that $T_\alpha x\to x$ for every $x\in X$. The bounded compact approximation constant $M(X)$ is the infimum of all such $C$.

It is known that for $1\le q\le p<\infty$ one has $M(H[L^{p,q}])\le 2$.

Problem. For $1\le q\le p<\infty$:
(a) Establish a nontrivial lower bound $M(H[L^{p,q}])>1$ (or determine the exact value) for the bounded compact approximation constant of the Hardy–Lorentz space $H[L^{p,q}]$.
(b) Improve the upper bound $M(H[L^{p,q}])\le 2$, ideally to a sharp estimate analogous to the bound $M(H^p)\le 2^{|1-2/p|}$ known for the classical Hardy spaces $H^p$ with $1<p<\infty$.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is stated as an explicit open problem in recent work on bounded compact and dual compact approximation properties of Hardy spaces. A web search did not reveal any subsequent publication establishing a nontrivial lower bound or improving the upper bound $M(H[L^{p,q}])\le 2$ for Hardy–Lorentz spaces, so the problem appears to remain open.
